notes: Samsung's spec table prints Folded/Unfolded as WIDTH x HEIGHT x DEPTH -- the second value is identical folded and unfolded (the hinge-axis dimension), so it is mapped to `height` and the first value to `width`. Samsung gives TWO folded thicknesses: 16.8mm '(Hinge)' and 13.8mm '(Sagging)'. Per the family rule the LARGER (16.8) is closed.depth and the hinge-side value (also 16.8) is depth_at_hinge; 13.8mm is the non-hinge/taper side. Unfolded thickness is also a pair: 6.9mm '(Frame)' and 6.0mm '(Screen)'; the larger frame value is recorded as open.depth. Cover-screen refresh rate is not stated -> null (only the Main Screen's 120Hz is stated, in body copy). No frame/back/glass materials in the release; Samsung Ultra Thin Glass is stated for the MAIN SCREEN only, which is the foldable panel, not the cover_glass of the closed device, so materials left null. Crease shape never stated -> null. || EVIDENCE SWEEP 2026-09-13: these values were present in the research pass but carried NO sources[] entry covering their field, so they were set to null per the registry rule (a value without a citation is an assertion, not evidence). Preserved verbatim here so a human can re-source rather than re-research: dimensions_mm.depth_at_hinge = 16.8; hinge.type = 'book'; hinge.axis = 'long'.
